help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Answers to the questions we are asked most.
help.contact_body: Tell us what is happening and we will take a look.
help.contact_tip: Before writing, the fastest fix for a missing survey is usually the checkout editor check in the first two answers above.
help.q_create: How do I create my survey?
help.a_create: The fastest way is Surveys › Quick start: pick where most of your buyers are, check the answers and press Go live. You can also pick a template under Surveys › Templates. Then add the block: in Shopify admin go to Settings › Checkout, click Customize, choose Thank you from the page menu at the top, add the “SourceTrac survey” block and press Save. You only add the block once.
help.q_not_showing: Why is the question not showing on my thank-you page?
help.a_not_showing: Four things are worth checking. First, the survey must be live in SourceTrac. Second, the “SourceTrac survey” block must be on the Thank you page in Shopify's checkout editor (Settings › Checkout › Customize, then Thank you in the page menu), and the editor saved. Third, each order is asked only once: an order that already answered never shows the survey again, so test with a new order. Fourth, Shopify does not offer the Thank you page block on the Starter plan.
help.q_missing_revenue: Why is one of my answers missing revenue?
help.a_missing_revenue: The buyer answered a moment before Shopify sent us the order, so we had their answer but not the order value yet. Revenue usually appears within a minute. If it is still missing after a day, the answer is shown as waiting rather than counted as zero, so your totals stay honest.
help.a_refunds: Refunded value is subtracted from the order total before it is attributed, so a refunded order contributes little or nothing. Cancelled and test orders are excluded from revenue entirely. Test orders are also excluded from your response rate.
help.q_limit: I reached my free limit. Did I lose my answers?
help.a_limit: No. Answers keep being collected, stored and counted in your dashboard totals. Nothing is hidden. Upgrading only removes the monthly limit.
help.q_privacy: Does SourceTrac ask for anything about my customers?
help.a_privacy: SourceTrac stores the answers, the order number and total, and a few details: the buyer's checkout language and country, the products and whether it was their first order. It never collects names, emails, phone numbers or addresses. Text buyers type is stored as written, so ask questions that don't invite personal details.
help.q_change: Can I change the question after going live?
help.a_change: Yes. Open the survey from Surveys, change it and save. A live survey updates from the next order. Answers already collected stay as they were.
help.a_cancel: Cancel from the Plans page. Your survey keeps working on the Free plan with {{cap}} responses a month, and nothing is deleted.
help.q_multiple: Can I run more than one survey?
help.a_multiple: Yes. Free has 1 live survey, Growth 10 and Scale no limit. Create them from Surveys. A thank-you page shows one survey at a time, chosen by priority.
help.q_question_types: What kinds of question can I ask?
help.a_question_types: Multiple choice, a single choice, a rating, a scale from 0 to 10, yes/no, and free text. You can show a question only when an earlier answer matches, and show questions one at a time on a phone.
help.q_sync: Why is Shopify sync not running?
help.a_sync: Sync tags orders and customers and only runs when Shopify has granted the matching permission. Reopen the app and approve the permissions, or leave them off. Your survey collects and reports either way.
help.q_once_per_order: I answered once and now the survey doesn't show. Why?
help.a_once_per_order: Each order is asked only once. After an answer, SourceTrac never shows that order the survey again, even if the page is reloaded, so buyers are never asked twice. To test again, place a new order.
help.q_order_status: Can the survey also show on the Order status page?
help.a_order_status: Yes, as an optional extra. The Order status page is where buyers land when they open “View your order” from their order emails. Tick it under “Where it shows” in the survey, then in the checkout editor choose Order status from the page menu, add the “SourceTrac survey” block and press Save. It's in the menu only if your store uses Shopify's new customer accounts (Settings › Customer accounts). Each order is still asked only once.
help.q_countries: My buyers are in several countries. Can the answers differ?
help.a_countries: Yes. In the survey editor, “Use answers for a country” loads the apps and sites buyers in a country usually find shops on. The globe button next to an answer shows it only to buyers in the countries you pick (Growth), so one survey can offer LINE in Japan and Snapchat in the Gulf. For different questions, duplicate the survey, limit it to those countries under “Who sees it” and move it above the other on the Surveys page.
help.q_look: Can I change the survey's colours and fonts?
help.a_look: The survey always uses your checkout's own fonts and colours (Settings › Checkout › Customize), because Shopify doesn't let apps change them, so it always looks like part of your store. Under “Look and wording” in the survey you can change the title, intro, button and thank-you text, show questions one at a time, use stars for ratings, set the words under a scale, and choose a border and spacing.
help.q_languages: Will buyers see the survey in their language?
help.a_languages: Templates and the quick start come translated into ten languages. Under “Languages” in the survey you can add or change translations, including Arabic, Hebrew, Korean, Polish, Turkish and the Nordic languages. A buyer sees their checkout language when the survey has it, and your own wording otherwise; the buttons are translated for all of these languages.

privacy.notice: SourceTrac keeps survey answers and order details for {{months}} months. It never stores buyer names, emails, phone numbers, addresses or payment details.
privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.intro: SourceTrac collects only what it needs to show which channels bring you sales. Here is all of it, in plain words.
privacy.collect_title: What SourceTrac stores for each answer
privacy.collect_order: The order: its ID, order number, total, currency, sales channel (such as online store or POS) and status (paid, refunded, cancelled or test)
privacy.collect_answers: The answers: the options the buyer picked, any score they gave and any text they typed
privacy.collect_context: Context: when they answered, which page it was on, their checkout language and country, the products in the order, and whether it was their first order
privacy.collect_store: About your store: your shop domain and the Shopify session the app needs to run
privacy.text_warning: Typed answers are stored exactly as the buyer wrote them. Ask questions that don't invite personal details such as names or emails.
privacy.never_body: Buyer names, email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses and payment details. SourceTrac does not ask Shopify for them.
privacy.why_body: Only to show you which channels and answers bring in orders and revenue. The data is not sold, shared with advertisers or used to profile buyers. It leaves SourceTrac only when you download a CSV, or when you turn on Shopify actions, which write answers to your own orders and customers in Shopify.
privacy.who_title: Who can see it and where it is kept
privacy.who_body: You and the staff you allow to use the app. The app runs on Render and the database is hosted by Neon. Data is sent over encrypted connections, and the Shopify access token is encrypted when stored.
privacy.keep_body: Answers and order details are deleted after {{months}} months. Webhook records, and the “Recent checkouts” list of which survey each order was shown, are deleted after {{days}} days. When you uninstall SourceTrac, Shopify asks us to delete all of your store's data 48 hours later, and we do.
privacy.rights_body: Buyers ask you, not SourceTrac, and Shopify forwards their requests to us. When a buyer asks for their data, we look up their answers and list the request on the Settings page. When a buyer asks to be erased, we delete their answers automatically.
privacy.contact_body: Write to {{email}} about anything on this page.
privacy.role_body: You decide what your survey asks, so for your buyers' data you are the controller and SourceTrac processes it for you. Mention the survey in your store's privacy policy. You can adapt this text:
privacy.policy_text: After checkout we may ask you a short optional survey, such as how you heard about us. Your answers are stored with your order number by our survey provider, SourceTrac, for up to {{months}} months, and are used only to understand which channels bring us customers. They are never sold or used for advertising.
privacy.actions_notice: Shopify actions copy answers into your Shopify store as order tags, customer tags or customer metafields. They then follow Shopify's rules for your store data, not SourceTrac's deletion schedule.
privacy.export_notice: The file contains order numbers, answers and order totals, and any text buyers typed. Keep it as safely as your other store records.
